description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractConfig' that manages common configuration properties for client and server components, including trust stores, key stores, TLS protocols, and related SSL/TLS settings. It includes methods to retrieve and set configuration parameters, derive trust and key options, and perform validity checks for files and formats.

classes.name: AbstractConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class providing shared configuration properties and logic for managing TLS/SSL trust and key stores, protocols, and related parameters used by clients and servers within the Hono project.

methods.name: isValidPort
methods.description: Checks if a given port number is valid (>= 0 and <= 65535).

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the character used to separate segments of target addresses.

methods.name: setPathSeparator
methods.description: Sets the separator character for target address segments.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the trust store file.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the path to the trust store file.

methods.name: getTrustStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the trust store as a String.

methods.name: setTrustStorePassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the trust store.

methods.name: getTrustOptions
methods.description: Derives TrustOptions based on the configured trust store files and format.

methods.name: getKeyStorePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the key store.

methods.name: setKeyStorePath
methods.description: Sets the path to the key store.

methods.name: getKeyStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the key store as a String.

methods.name: setKeyStorePassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the key store.

methods.name: getKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Derives KeyCertOptions based on key, cert, or keystore configuration.

methods.name: getCertPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the PEM-encoded certificate chain.

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the PEM-encoded certificate chain.

methods.name: getKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the PEM-encoded private key.

methods.name: setKeyPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the PEM-encoded private key.

methods.name: setTrustStoreFormat
methods.description: Explicitly sets the format of the trust store.

methods.name: getTrustStoreFormat
methods.description: Returns the explicitly set trust store format or null for auto-detection.

methods.name: setKeyFormat
methods.description: Explicitly sets the format of the key files.

methods.name: getKeyFormat
methods.description: Returns the explicitly set key format or null for auto-detection.

methods.name: getSecureProtocols
methods.description: Returns the list of enabled TLS protocols.

methods.name: setSecureProtocols
methods.description: Sets the list of enabled TLS protocols.
